name: Bissell CleanView Upright Vacuum
description: Powerful bagless upright vacuum cleaner featuring OnePass Technology with a specialized brush design to clean on the initial pass. Uses a Multi-Cyclonic cleaning system for consistent suction and includes a 2.0L bottom easy-empty dirt tank. Comes equipped with a 25-foot power cord, a 6-foot hose, a 13.5-inch cleaning path width, and standard on-board tools (TurboBrush tool, dusting brush, crevice tool, and extension wand). Suitable for multiple surface types including low pile carpet, stairs, and bare floors.
meta_description: Buy a pre-owned BISSELL CleanView Upright Vacuum 1330 in good condition. Features powerful cyclonic suction, bagless easy-empty tank, and multi-surface attachments.
name_zh: 必胜 CleanView 直立式吸尘器
description_zh: 搭载 OnePass 技术的高效无袋直立式吸尘器，配有独特的滚刷设计，可在初次吸尘时高效清洁。采用多气旋清洁系统提供持久吸力，配备 2.0 升大容量易倾倒集尘盒。带有 25 英尺电源线、6 英尺软管、13.5 英寸清洁宽度，并随附车载清洁工具（涡轮除螨刷、除尘刷、缝隙吸头和延长杆）。适用于低绒地毯、楼梯和硬质地面等多种材质表面。
